# essi vendor sepolicy (generated)

Everything in this directory is generated by `tools/cil2te.py` from Samsung's stock
A566BXXS6AYGE vendor policy (`reference/stock/vendor/etc/selinux`). Re-run the tool instead
of editing files here; see `docs/APPROACH.md` and `docs/cil2te_report.md`.

Wired into the build by `BOARD_VENDOR_SEPOLICY_DIRS` in `device/BoardConfig.mk`.
